question: How should Taiwan stock-level day-trading activity be interpreted across TWSE and TPEx without confusing surveillance thresholds, same-day turnover, and revised data vintages with directional alpha?

TWSE.product: Objects and Statistics for Day Trading / 當日沖銷交易標的及統計
fields: market day-trading volume and market share
market day-trading buy/sell values and market shares
TWSE.interpretation: same-session turnover composition, not overnight position stock

TPEx.product: 現股當沖交易統計資訊
TPEx.publication: published after broker reporting/adjustment workflow completes; exact T-day clock is variable
vintageRule: T+2 update is the final correct value
TPEx.consequence: Historical finalized pages cannot recreate the original T-day first-known snapshot unless an actual prospective receipt was preserved.

trigger: latest six-business-day day-trading volume / total volume > 60%
exemptions: initial listing common shares during no-price-limit period
ETF and active ETF beneficial certificates
specified repeat-attention exception under the rule
TWSEArticle14.forbiddenUse: Do not reuse 60% as a predictive buy/sell threshold or optimize around it as if regulator surveillance implied return direction.

keyFalsification: High day-trading ratio can coexist with healthy liquidity/price discovery or fragile speculation; sign is conditional.
Day-trading buy and sell values are mechanically linked by same-day round trips and do not identify overnight directional inventory.
A regulatory attention threshold is designed for surveillance, not for forecasting returns.
ETFs are exempt from the cited high-day-trading surveillance criterion, proving the threshold is not a universal economic crowding boundary.
TPEx T-day and T+2 values are different vintages; using later finalized history as if known at T-day creates look-ahead.
A fixed TWSE ~20:00 production clock must not be imputed to TPEx, whose T-day completion time depends on broker reporting and revisions.

vintageLabels.TWSE: T_EOD_2000_CONTRACT when actual receipt confirms same-day product

maturityDecision.reason: TWSE same-day production contract is strong, but TPEx same-day first-known clock is variable and historical T+2 finalized values cannot recreate T-day PIT; prospective cross-market receipts are still required before L3.

status: MECHANISM_AND_FALSIFICATION_DEFINED / TWSE_SOURCE_CLOCK_VERIFIED / TPEX_MULTI_VINTAGE_SEMANTICS_FROZEN / SURVEILLANCE_THRESHOLD_NOT_ALPHA / PROSPECTIVE_RECEIPT_REQUIRED / OUTCOMES_CLOSED / FORMAL_UNCHANGED
exactNext: On the next valid trading day, preserve an actual T-day TPEx receipt with capturedAt/hash and later T+1/T+2 revisions for the same date. Compare vintage deltas outcome-blind. Keep TWSE 20:00 and TPEx variable clocks separate. No standalone day-trading score or 60% alpha threshold.
